pages.title: Next step
text: One concrete thing to do, read from where you are on the path from the first hearth to the Ninth Agreement. It changes as you go.
Once your camp makes its own power, follow whatever you are curious about:
- [Workshops](echo_attune) turn shards into stronger crystals, metals and upgrades.
- [Camp Machines](grove_tender) farm, gather and guard while you are busy.
- [Storage & Cargo](ancestral_cache) keeps your goods and moves them without pipes, and [compasses and gates](waystone_compass) move you.
- [Patterns](placement_is_the_ritual) are built rather than crafted: the Stone Font and the Listening Pit.
- A [familiar](familiar_basics) carries a totem's voice and makes your magic of that voice stronger.
- [The Nine Tribes](standing) keep camps across the land. Feed a hearth to earn trades, boons and, in time, a Kinship Totem.
- With friends, a [shared camp](shared_camps) shares a vault, devices and Wayanchors.
- The [Gate Drum](gate_drum) opens the way to the March, when you are ready for it.
